Messages.Author: bacchus183
Messages.Body:
In the Vampire RPG a vampire could only follow one Path (Lilith, Feral
Heart, etc.), and since the game does a really good job of following
the RPG world, i thought i logical to ask if a player could have more
than one Path out at a time, say A Path of Metamorphosis and a Path of
Lilith for example. Is their any rule against that that I'm not aware
of?
